description:
Gwak Chi-Eon, who just turned 20, surprises the adults by declaring that he will not go to college, but in fact, he has a clearer goal than anything else. To win over Hyun Woo-Jong, who lives next door and is his destiny! Woo-Jong, whom we have known since he was little, is the type who is very playful and has a lot of casual romances. However, he cares for Chi-Eon very much and keeps revealing his possessiveness, which confuses him. Chi-Eon, who has decided that it is time to make a full-fledged move now that he has become a respectable adult, pulls himself together and approaches Woo-Jong with all his heart...?!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
